description: A console-style player anchors a one-page music production portfolio for an Austin producer and engineer. It streams 188 tracks across music, sessions, and productions, with waveform scrubbing, VU meters, and a catalog filtered by key, year, and BPM. Waveforms render from peak data extracted with ffmpeg ahead of time, and WAV downloads sit behind a PIN checked in a Netlify edge function.
name: Aephonics - Music
